395367.name: Chabad Student Center
395367.note: Lubavitch News Service (CrownHeights.info, 3 Dec 2005): of the 19 representatives Chabad on Campus sent to colleges 'this year', teams 'have gone out to ... Florida Atlantic/Lynn University'. Chabad.org (19 March 2025): Rabbi Boruch Shmuel Liberow 'has served as a Chabad emissary at FAU for 20 years'. Both give 2005. Chabad.org (5 Oct 2011): its free-mezuzah drive was in its fourth year. The Chabad Student Center also serves Lynn University and Palm Beach State College.

119142.name: Mikvah
119142.note: CrownHeights.info, 28 Feb 2006 (Chabad of Sarasota's dinner): 'Compared to the small guest room in Rabbi Steinmetz' apartment which served as Chabad headquarters when he first arrived to the city 15 years ago, the Chabad house currently boasts three centers, an elegant Mikvah, a preschool and a school for Jewish studies.' So the mikvah existed by early 2006; when it opened is not found. Lead: the chabad.org listing is from about 2003.

887237.name: Chabad of North Broward Beaches
887237.note: CrownHeights.info, 26 March 2009 ('New Shluchim to Florida!'): 'Rabbi Tzvi and his wife Shana (nee Biston) Dechter ... will IYH be moving out on Shlichus to Lighthouse Point, FL where they will establish a new Chabad House serving the local Jewish residents in East Deerfield Beach, East Pompano Beach, and Hillsboro Beach'; appointed by Rabbi Yossi Biston of Chabad of North Broward and South Palm Beach. Its own undated About page ('serving the Broward Beaches community for almost 2 years') fits text written about 2011.
